purpose: 홈 섹션 사이 사진 등록 유도 칸의 실제 서울 지도와 실제 사진
method: OpenStreetMap static SVG floor + original licensed photos + built-in image_gen transparent 3D accent, composed as native DOM layers

map.projection: js/photo-contribution-art.mjs: projectContributionLocation, shared by offline floor renderer and live photo pins
map.simplification: Actual coordinates simplified at 0.55 artwork pixels. The decorative floor omits residential roads and labels for clarity; major roads, pedestrian paths, waterways and parks retain their actual geometry. No proprietary map tiles or runtime map API.

photoProcessing: Resize full frame to320x240 and WebP quality78/effort6. Original color, composition and photographer watermark retained; no generative retouching or crop. BY-SA remains attached to the corresponding photo derivatives, not the entire application.

landmark.method: built-in image_gen edit using existing v2 illustration as style reference, transparent_background true
landmark.prompt: Create only one isolated3D Namsan hill and N Seoul Tower sprite, maintaining the supplied light matte editorial miniature style. Small slim white communications tower with subtle red antenna and grey observation deck, sage-green hill, rounded trees, two small plain ivory apartment blocks near hill edge. Gentle oblique view, soft daylight top-left. Remove all map roads, flat ground, river, photos, pins, text, haze, vignette and large shadow. Fully transparent irregular base; no logo or labels. Place later at actual Namsan coordinates on independently rendered2D OSM floor.
landmark.conversion: Sharp trim transparent margin, resize360px, WebP quality80/effort6; no map or photo content edited with Sharp

delivery.loading: five local lazy-loaded images, static pin SVG, no external map/photo requests
